clue.text: Afterthought to take in concerning old forecast

indicators.note: the afterthought is made to take in, that is to enclose, the next piece

parts.note: PS, postscript, is an afterthought added to a letter
RE means concerning, as in a memo heading
aged means old

explanation.surface: Someone adds a postscript about an old prediction.
explanation.definitionFit: To presage something is to foretell or predict it, so presaged is a past-tense synonym.

clue.text: Direct official dismissing two characters at the end

indicators.text: dismissing two characters at the end
indicators.note: the official loses his final pair of letters, sent off like a dismissed player

parts.note: a referee is a sports official

explanation.surface: A referee is told to send off two players late in the game.
explanation.definitionFit: To refer someone to a place is to direct them there; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Small amounts of stuff consumed by rats

indicators.note: the stuff is eaten, so it ends up inside the other piece

parts.note: to rat on someone is to inform, or sing; here rats is a verb meaning sings
matter means stuff, material

explanation.surface: Bits of food are nibbled away by rodents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rats' looks like the animals but is the verb: a rat informs, and so does someone who sings to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A smattering is a slight amount or superficial knowledge, so smatterings are small quantities.

clue.text: Shrub from area in middle of bed to pull up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards, backwards
takes the central letter of the word bed

parts.note: to drag is to pull

explanation.surface: A gardener uproots a plant from the centre of a flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The gardenia is an evergreen flowering bush with scented white blooms.

clue.text: Biblical tale roughly: lad did endless havoc with giant

indicators.note: roughly means the letters are treated loosely and rearranged
the word havoc loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written, minus its end

explanation.surface: A rough retelling: a boy wreaked havoc on a giant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims havoc to HAVO; with LAD, DID and GIANT that is the full pool of fifteen letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament story in which the shepherd boy fells the Philistine champion with a sling.

clue.text: Resistance to backing figure that's bad

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for resistance

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the little word to is read backwards

parts.note: ten is a figure, a number

explanation.surface: Supporting a poor statistic is a bad idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotten is a colloquial synonym for bad, of poor quality or decayed.

clue.text: Withdrawal of soldiers on exercises, all cut short

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
PE, physical education

indicators.note: the word all loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written, then trimmed

explanation.surface: Troops are pulled out of manoeuvres, which all end early.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeal is the revoking or annulment of a law, a formal withdrawal of it.

clue.text: Height of clipped shot

indicators.note: clipped means the end is cut off the word

parts.note: shot can mean worn out or ruined, like torn

explanation.surface: How high a cut-short shot rises.
explanation.definitionFit: A tor is a rocky hill or peak, especially on Dartmoor in south-west England, so a height.

clue.text: Craft ales in set required

indicators.note: to craft is to shape or make, so the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: Craft beers are a must in any collection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Craft' pretends to describe the ales, as in craft beer, but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something essential is necessary or needed, a synonym of required.

clue.text: Answer really loudly and declare business

parts.note: FF, fortissimo, the musical mark for very loud
to air a view is to declare it

explanation.surface: Someone replies at full volume and announces their trade.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter or concern, as in 'that is my business'.

clue.text: Destroy vessel crossing river with unlimited brio

indicators.note: the vessel straddles the other pieces, holding them inside

parts.note: a vase is a vessel
the Po is the great river of northern Italy

indicators.note: without its limits, the outer letters of brio are dropped

explanation.surface: A boat crosses a river with less than full energy.
explanation.definitionFit: To vaporise something is to annihilate it, turning it to vapour, as with a ray gun.

clue.text: Anguish for gent regularly overlooked

indicators.note: every other letter is passed over, leaving the alternate ones

explanation.surface: A man is distressed at being repeatedly ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: To fret is to worry or agonise; as a noun it is a state of anxious distress.

clue.text: Close attention by chaps, tons giving affection

parts.note: the close of something is its end
to give an ear is to pay attention
chaps are men

explanation.surface: Fellows pay heavy attention, showing fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: An endearment is a word or act expressing love, a token of fondness.

clue.text: Wrongly understand disadvantages in fog on French road

indicators.note: the disadvantages are placed in the fog

parts.note: mist is a light fog
pros and cons: cons are drawbacks
rue is French for street

explanation.surface: Getting the wrong idea about the hazards of a misty French road.
explanation.definitionFit: To misconstrue is to misinterpret or take something the wrong way.

clue.text: Sign with tip of nettle that one's a stinger

parts.note: Scorpio is a sign of the zodiac

indicators.note: the tip of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A nettle's point announces itself as something that stings.
explanation.definitionFit: The arachnid has a venomous barb on its tail, so it is a creature that stings.

clue.text: Arch villain very old getting topped

parts.note: a cur is a scoundrel or contemptible man

indicators.note: in a down clue, topping removes the first letter

parts.note: mature means grown old

explanation.surface: An arch-villain of great age is finally executed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arch' looks like an adjective on 'villain' but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An arch is a curved structure, and curvature is the state of bending in such a curve.

clue.text: Lose footing after lager's knocked back

indicators.note: drinks are knocked back, and back here sends the word in reverse

parts.note: Pils, short for Pilsner, is a pale lager

explanation.surface: Someone falls over after downing a beer.
explanation.definitionFit: To slip is to slide and lose one's balance underfoot.

clue.text: Fought with editor after others left

indicators.note: after says the editor comes after the other pieces

parts.note: the rest are the others

explanation.surface: An editor squabbled once the others had gone.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrestle is to grapple or struggle, so wrestled is a synonym of fought.

clue.text: Returning rook feeding young bird

indicators.note: returning means the combined letters are read backwards
the rook is fed into the young, going inside it

parts.note: new means young, recent
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A rook flies back to feed its chick.
explanation.definitionFit: The wren is a tiny brown songbird of Europe.

clue.text: Monstrosity of old yard covered in swill

indicators.note: the pieces are covered by, so placed within, the swill

parts.note: to gargle is to swill liquid round the mouth

explanation.surface: An ugly thing from an old farmyard covered in pig swill.
explanation.definitionFit: A gargoyle is a grotesque carved figure on a building, hence an ugly monster.

clue.text: Test horse going round track before start of race

indicators.note: the horse encircles the other pieces

parts.note: a dun is a greyish-brown horse

indicators.note: before puts the track ahead of the next letter

parts.note: RY, railway, a track for trains

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A horse trial: one lap of the course before the race begins.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry run is a rehearsal or trial run before the real thing.

clue.text: So careless breaking dishes

indicators.note: breaking means the letters are smashed apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone so clumsy they keep smashing the crockery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dishes' looks like the plates being broken, but it is the definition: stews.
explanation.definitionFit: A casserole is a stew cooked slowly in the oven, and so a dish.

clue.text: Hollow space dry home for animal

indicators.note: hollowed out, the word space keeps only its outer letters

parts.note: TT, teetotal, means not drinking alcohol

explanation.surface: An empty dry hole is home for a creature.
explanation.walkthrough: A sett is a badger's burrow.
explanation.definitionFit: A sett is the den of a badger, the burrow where it lives.

clue.text: Dance in tartan gown

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Taking to the floor in a plaid dress.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is an Argentine ballroom dance.

clue.text: Being in the grip of virus, large strain for country

indicators.note: the virus grips, so encloses, the next piece

parts.note: a bug is a virus or infection
a strain is a tune, and an aria is a song

explanation.surface: A big viral strain takes hold of a nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strain' suggests a variant of the virus but means a melody.
explanation.definitionFit: Bulgaria is a Balkan nation on the Black Sea.

clue.text: Break a doctor binds

indicators.note: the doctor binds round, enclosing, the letter a

parts.note: GP, general practitioner, a family doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor puts a bandage on a fracture.
explanation.definitionFit: A gap is a break or opening in something.

clue.text: Organ and a rodent's head eaten by cat

indicators.note: the eaten pieces end up inside the cat

parts.note: a lynx is a wild cat

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A wild cat devours a rodent's head and some innards.
explanation.definitionFit: The larynx is the voice box, an organ in the throat.

clue.text: Magnify fourth letter by writer

parts.note: D, the fourth letter of the alphabet, spelled out
a pen is something that writes

explanation.surface: Enlarging the fourth letter of something written.
explanation.definitionFit: To deepen is to intensify or increase, as magnify can mean.

clue.text: Manner in which to hold garden tool for trimming line of bushes

indicators.note: the manner holds, so contains, the tool

parts.note: how is a manner of doing
an edger trims lawn edges

explanation.surface: Instructions on gripping shears to trim a row of shrubs.
explanation.definitionFit: A hedgerow is a row of shrubs and small trees bordering a field.
